svg.title: The coefficient can be read in the position-space frame by a finite determining system. This step distinguishes the formal first even coefficient from the later real remainder estimate. Let O = Oscale, let T 0 be the normalized free Maxwell stress tensor, and write δv for the tensor δabv. For a real invertible degree-four frame Ps preserving the stated conjugation and symmetries, the physical tensor decomposition is P −1 s (s4Tab) = κsT 0 ab + dsδabO + esδab1. (TR76)
